Your eleven projects 60.8 points without the armband, or 69.0 with it on Haaland. That's a competitive total. Haaland has the captain's band and leads Salah by 0.3 in projection; he also carries 25% upside to double figures and only an 8% tail risk of scoring 2 or fewer.

You're holding your free transfer. No swap beats the cost of making it, which is the right call.

Three of your starting players wear Arsenal shirts and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. That's a tight cluster, but it reflects where the model sees value rather than a warning sign in itself.

The bench is thin — Mykolenko projects 3.1 — so rotation will bite if anyone in the eleven drops out. Beyond that, you're set for the week.

Your eleven projects 60.8, rising to 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. He is a clear captain choice: 0.3 points ahead of Salah, with a quarter chance of hitting double figures and only an 8% risk of blanking badly. Salah remains the logical alternative if you want to hedge.

You have three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City. The structure is sound and the bench offers little incentive to tinker — Mykolenko's 3.1 is well short of any of your starting forwards. You will keep your free transfer this week.

The model found no swap worth taking. This does not mean the eleven is immobile; it means nothing clears the 4-point cost within the projection window. Watch the team news before deadline in case that changes the calculus, but you are well-placed to hold.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. He is 0.3 clear of Salah and carries meaningful upside—a quarter chance of reaching double figures—alongside realistic downside risk. The armband call is tight but defensible.

You are anchored in three Arsenal players and two each at Liverpool and Manchester City. That concentration at Arsenal and the two big clubs reflects their form and your bench strength, which is thin: Mykolenko at 3.1 is the only reserve worth mentioning, and he trails the starting eleven sharply. The 3-4-3 shape is conventional enough given those names.

No transfer improves the projection at the cost of a point, so you are holding. Your bank stands at £0.5m with one free transfer remaining, so you have room to move if the week uncovers an edge you want to chase.
